verdict.rationale: Ultrametric documents a few versioning primitives of its own. Hosted process guides can be pinned to a specific integer version. Run and record history can be retrieved for review. Updates carry revisions so one session does not overwrite another. This is only a glancing fit for versioning and reviewing automations; committing skill files to git is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: user-authored automation versioning, a documented review/diff workflow, an explicit rollback/restore operation, and hands-on corroboration (all hosted context operations were auth-walled in probes).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations

citations.quote: To select a specific version, replace `VERSION` with its positive integer version number
For history, select one record or run: ultrametric context get --record RECORD_ID --history --json
An update to an existing record must include its current revision so one session does not overwrite another session's changes.
